summary: Use a closing question in the body as the call to action when no cta was supplied.
root_cause: With no cta supplied the prompt asks the post to end on a question; the model ends the body with that question and leaves cta empty, so the handler stops with validation_failed ('the draft lacks a hook, a body, a call to action or a usable hashtag').
expected_impact: Posts whose closing question was left in the body pass validation; no prompt change, so recorded replies still apply.
author: fixture: the handler hunk of commit 544f65c (2026-11-15), replayed as an M6 candidate
